name: reanalyze
description: Analyzers for Dead Code/Types and termination in OCaml

scripts.dce: dune build && dune exec reanalyze.exe -- -suppress dead-code-ppx -unsuppress doesnotexist -dce-cmt _build
scripts.exception: dune build && dune exec reanalyze.exe -- -suppress src/ext -exception-cmt _build

author: Cristiano Calcagno
